title: Feature-Adaptive Fusion in Hybrid Quantum-Classical Neural Networks for Robust Biomedical Image Classification
summary: Hybrid quantum-classical neural networks provide a promising approach for incorporating quantum circuits into machine learning in the noisy intermediate-scale quantum regime. However, existing hybrid models often rely on fixed or globally shared fusion strategies, which may limit their ability to exploit complementary information carried by quantum branches, especially under distribution shifts.
